jsonld.name: Wedding Budget Calculator
jsonld.description: Splits a wedding budget into typical categories with contingency, cost per guest and payment stages.

mainEntity.name: How much should a wedding cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends heavily on location and guest count. Recent US surveys put the average around $30,000 to $36,000, but many weddings cost far less.

mainEntity.name: How much should I set aside for contingency?

acceptedAnswer.text: About 10% is common. It covers price rises, extra guests, overtime and surprise fees.

mainEntity.name: What is the biggest wedding cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The venue and catering, often 40% to 45% of the budget. Cutting the guest list is the most effective way to cut costs.

mainEntity.name: How are vendor payments usually scheduled?

acceptedAnswer.text: A deposit at signing, often 25% to 50%, a second payment weeks before, and the balance on or just before the day. Check each contract.

mainEntity.name: What if I bring my own vendors?

acceptedAnswer.text: You may save on catering markups but pay for rentals, staffing and coordination separately, so those get their own line here.
